answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. Top-1 agreement 0.865 and sequence agreement 0.344 fall in the system-prompted range (0.861-0.908 and 0.31-0.48) and below the fine-tuned range (0.900-0.938 and 0.47-0.64). TV 0.146 and Token-DiFR gap 0.529 sit at or just above the top of the system-prompted range, and KL 0.429 is above it. All three are far beyond the quantized and fine-tuned ranges. The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 3.7 fits system-prompted (3.3-3.9). It is not base, since the values are non-zero. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, but its top-1 agreement, TV and DiFR gap are all too low, although its ratio range is wide.
